title: RFC 4180 CSV Parser
description: Demonstrator node for the shared _csv.bundle.mjs kernel (SHARED-CSV-AND-PAGE-XML-1): a deterministic RFC 4180 parser over a caller-supplied CSV string -- quoted fields, embedded commas and CRLF inside quotes, doubled-quote decoding, CRLF record breaks (bare LF accepted and flagged, bare CR refused), a leading UTF-8 BOM stripped and flagged, declared byte/row/column caps enforced before parsing with structured refusals, a header map, and a per-column summary. Every field value is returned as a decoded string, never numerically coerced. When sanitize_export is true, export-echoed values pass through the estate's CSV-injection guard (the _csv_injection.mjs SSOT, inlined verbatim -- the OWASP formula-prefix rule). The bundle is the reuse vehicle for CSV-ingesting wave kernels; this node gives it an execution_hash surface, a fixture set, a PBT floor and a section 18 proof surface.

csv_text.description: The CSV table as a plain string, already extracted by the caller (E2.parse doctrine: the zk guest has no DOMParser and this kernel deliberately contains no markup tokenizer). Capped by max_bytes (default 1,000,000 UTF-8 bytes), max_rows (default 10,000 data records) and max_cols (default 512).

header.description: When true (default), the first record is treated as the column-name header row and is excluded from the returned data records and used for the column names in the summary.

summarize.description: When true (default), the output includes column_summary: per-column name, non_empty_count, empty_count, min_length and max_length over the decoded string values.

sanitize_export.description: When true, every data value echoed toward an export surface is passed through the CSV-injection guard (OWASP formula-prefix rule: a leading = + - @ TAB or CR receives a literal apostrophe prefix) and fully RFC 4180 quoted serialized rows are returned. When false (default), the parse stays a faithful decode and any risk value only sets the CSV_INJECTION_RISK_UNSANITIZED flag.

max_bytes.description: Override for the UTF-8 byte cap. An over-cap input is refused whole (INPUT_TOO_LARGE), never truncated.

max_rows.description: Override for the data-record cap. An over-cap input is refused whole (TOO_MANY_ROWS), never truncated.

max_cols.description: Override for the per-record field cap. An over-cap record is refused whole (TOO_MANY_COLUMNS), never truncated.

mcp_tool_definition.name: parse_csv_table
mcp_tool_definition.description: Parses a CSV table string per RFC 4180 (quoted fields, embedded CRLF, doubled quotes, BOM stripped and flagged, declared caps with structured refusals) and returns decoded string records plus a per-column summary; optional OWASP CSV-injection sanitization for export echo.

source: authored by SHARED-CSV-AND-PAGE-XML-1 per ACCT-INFRA-KERNELS-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec 0.1 (bundle + demonstrator ruling) and the row's own fence. Parse grammar pinned to RFC 4180 Section 2 (clause snapshot registered in chaingraph/standard/clause-snapshot-registry.json, digest sha256:d9179e244fe88c91b043fb1c56e57d4393fd245ef3c675c344c5c586e1bc4a6a; two declared deviations named in the bundle header: bare LF accepted and flagged, bare CR refused). CSV-injection guard inlined VERBATIM from chaingraph/kernels/_csv_injection.mjs (WORKBOOK-1-BUILD-SPEC.md Sec WB-5 SSOT), never re-derived. Golden fixtures derive from the RFC grammar cases plus the malformed/cap set, filled from the kernel's own compute() by chaingraph/kernels/fill-fixture-payloads.mjs. human_sign_off PENDING.
